semiconductor_relevance: High — SiPearl designs high-performance CPUs specifically for HPC and AI applications, which are critical components in the semiconductor industry.
summary: SiPearl is a European fabless designer specializing in secure, high-performance, energy-efficient CPUs aimed at high-performance computing (HPC), artificial intelligence (AI), and data center applications. Their first-generation CPU, Rhea1, is set to support European exascale supercomputers, addressing key strategic challenges in various sectors.

regional_presence.France: SiPearl has a significant presence in France, employing a portion of its 200 staff there.
regional_presence.Spain: The company also operates in Spain as part of its European strategy.
regional_presence.Italy: SiPearl has a presence in Italy, contributing to its workforce and operations.
